text: R19-13. **Correction to R19-12 / R16-1: the duplicate-import build error also happens on main WITHOUT the Guest actor** (full `./judo.sh generate` + `build -i` after switching back: `webshop__admin` `pnpm run format` fails on `dialogs/ImportRunInfo/.../StartImport/.../customization.ts`: `import type { ShopMessage, ShopMessage, ...}`). So "a third actor" is not the (only) trigger; the trigger is in the admin operation dialogs with an input AND an output TO (StartImport, ExportOrders, ...). Not investigated further; the running app is the build from before (backend and frontend bundles unchanged). The Admin and Customer UI can still be changed with the Vite dev server (no format step).
note: Catalog build-process.md 'Duplicate type imports with a third actor (known issue)' currently blames a stale model for the two-actor case; that guess is likely wrong: R19-15 shows the shared output TO trigger.

text: R19-15. **Cause of the admin build error narrowed (R16-1 / R19-13), with a workaround for the first half.** (1) Without a third actor the duplicate imports appeared only for the pages with an operation WITHOUT input next to operations with the same output TO (`ImportRunInfo.undo` -> ShopMessage beside `startImport`): giving `undo` its own output TO `UndoMessage` (+ `fill`) made the build pass again; the generated dialogs of other ops then no longer duplicated. (2) With the `Guest` actor (re-added on main with the same commands) EVERY admin dialog with an output TO duplicates its imports (`ShopMessage`, `CsvFile`): the third actor is still a blocker, build `-i` fails in `webshop__admin`. Guest was removed again from main (branch `guest-actor` keeps it). The catalog does not mention either trigger.

R19-17. **Third-actor build error (R16-1, R19-12/13/15): SOLVED by the position of the actor in the model.** With `Guest` created at index 0 (`create -t ActorType -n Guest ... --index 0`, first in file order) the admin frontend generates without duplicate imports; created last it does not (alphabetical name does not matter, file order does). This is the real trigger: the generated imports helper builds a set of class types per page and a type reached through two actor copies is counted twice when the new actor is not first. The catalog documents neither the problem nor the order rule (dual-actor-frontend-architecture.md promises three actors).
note: Find the exact cause in the ESM->UI transformation (Zeta default: runtime__judo-tatami-client/judo-tatami-esm2ui/.../zeta/Esm2UiZetaTransformation.java executeForActorType, fix* post-processing, shared UI resource and ModelProvider over the resource set, static caches in zeta/extensions; ETL path Esm2Ui.java:159) and in judo-ui-react UiPageHelper.getApiImportsForPage (HashSet<ClassType> identity). Observed: order Customer,Admin + undo/startImport sharing output TO -> admin duplicates; Customer,Admin,Guest -> every admin dialog with output TO duplicates; Guest,Customer,Admin -> passes. Determine the exact rule and the line(s). Reproduce on a scratch Sandbox copy with 2-3 actors and transform -o if it helps (inspect UI XMI for ClassType references whose id prefix is another actor).
